issue_context.title: Pasting content from the clipboard on an empty text element is not working
issue_context.body:
If I create a text element outside a container, and then try to paste the content on my clipboard, nothing happens.
However, if I create a text element inside of a rectangle, for example, I can succesfuly paste the content.

I tested on Firefox, Edge, and Chrome and the issue can be replicated on all of them.
comments:
@dvsshadow I'm pretty sure this was a regression in #5845, which assumed the text was in a container.  I pushed a fix for this to #5835.
cc @ad1992 @dwelle

Yep, this is a regression that got introduced in my PR :(. @DanielJGeiger since you have pushed a fix for this, can you create a separate PR for this fix with a test as well? I would like to push the fix first as its a regression

Missed this issue. Reopening as there are numerous issues with this still.

I could list the issues still present, but I'm sure I'd miss some. We should try to find a different solution for https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/5834 and avoid reimplementing text editor behavior unless absolutely necessary.

review_comments:
Haven't tested the perf but I think calling this function on every keystroke would turn out to be very expensive.
Right now in prod its called once per keystroke and in this PR its called thrice which will significantly affect the perf

Also, we should avoid calling this function here since we are trying the compute the position of text in the container which could be accurately determined from container dimensions.
I have updated this PR to address the perf issues you mentioned.
